text: Never have I ever had a romantic dream so good I was disappointed to wake up
Never have I ever been genuinely swept off my feet by someone
Never have I ever stayed up past 3am because I couldn't stop talking to someone I liked
Never have I ever cancelled plans to spend more time with someone I had feelings for
Never have I ever felt instant chemistry with a complete stranger
Never have I ever whispered something in someone's ear that made them blush
Never have I ever been someone's reason to come back to a city
Never have I ever had a 'this is the one' moment in a relationship
Never have I ever flirted shamelessly and absolutely meant every word
Never have I ever received a compliment that I still think about years later
Never have I ever been told I was someone's favourite person
Never have I ever kissed someone for the first time and immediately wanted to do it again
Never have I ever been someone's plus-one to something fancy
Never have I ever had a memorable romantic moment in an unexpected location
Never have I ever slow danced in a kitchen at midnight
Never have I ever been in a situationship that I genuinely didn't mind
Never have I ever had my heart race just from eye contact across a room
Never have I ever held someone's hand and known it meant everything
Never have I ever made the first move and been glad I did
Never have I ever had a moment I wanted to pause and live in forever
Never have I ever told someone exactly how I felt, no editing
Never have I ever planned a surprise that I was more nervous about than they were
Never have I ever had someone show up at my door completely unexpectedly and loved it
Never have I ever spent an entire day with someone and wished it hadn't ended
Never have I ever been in love and known it without question
